name: astrologyapp
description: Your real birth chart, transits and best days inside ChatGPT, read by your personal astrologer.

interface.longDescription:
AstrologyApp turns ChatGPT into your personal astrologer, working from your real birth chart instead of guesses. Connect your account and ask about your day, your week, your month, your solar return year, the best days for a plan, or the Moon calendar. The app provides exact chart data (tropical zodiac, Placidus houses, aspects with orbs and strength) for your own charts; ChatGPT does the interpretation in your language.

What you can ask: how today's sky touches your chart, what the week looks like for work or love, when a transit peaks, which days this month suit signing, launching, travelling or resting, what your solar return highlights, and what your natal placements mean.

Requirements and limits: only charts with the Full Map (Mapa Completo) on AstrologyApp are connected. Charts without it stay private and the app points you to where to activate it. You can search a birth city and create a new chart for yourself or, with their permission, for someone close to you. The app never buys anything, deletes charts or changes your account. It returns calculations only, never pre-written horoscopes, so every answer is based on your chart. Available in Portuguese, English, Spanish, German, French and Italian.
capabilities: Year ahead and life cycle calculations
defaultPrompt: How does today's sky touch my chart?
What does this week look like for my work, according to my chart?
Which days this month are best for signing a contract?

positive.expected_behavior: Shows the account's Full Map charts with Sun, Moon and Ascendant, and mentions how many charts are not connected yet.

positive.prompt: What is my rising sign and which house is my Moon in?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the Ascendant sign and the Moon's house exactly as shown on the AstrologyApp site, then interprets them briefly.
Reads today's strongest aspects to the natal chart (tightest orbs first) and relates them to the user's life areas, without inventing positions.

positive.prompt: Best days to sign a contract in the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of dated windows with the astrological reasons from the tool result.

positive.prompt: Create a chart for my sister Ana, born 1992-03-10 at 14:20 in Lisbon. She agreed.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Lisbon, creates the chart with third_party_consent set, returns Sun, Moon and Ascendant, and explains the chart is connected after its Full Map.

negative.prompt: What does my week look like for the chart that has no Full Map?
Create a chart for my boss, born 1980-01-01 in Paris.
Buy the Full Map for my sister's chart with my card.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Purchases happen only on the AstrologyApp website.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: natal chart, today's sky, weekly and monthly transits, solar return, sky events, best days, Moon calendar, chart creation.

pt-BR.subtitle: Seu mapa astral, no chat
pt-BR.description: O AstrologyApp transforma o ChatGPT no seu astrólogo pessoal, trabalhando com o seu mapa astral real em vez de palpites. Conecte a sua conta e pergunte sobre o seu dia, a sua semana, o seu mês, o seu ano (revolução solar), os melhores dias para um plano ou o calendário da Lua. O app fornece os dados exatos do mapa (zodíaco tropical, casas Placidus, aspectos com orbe e intensidade) dos seus mapas; o ChatGPT interpreta, no seu idioma. Só mapas com Mapa Completo no AstrologyApp ficam conectados. O app nunca compra nada, não apaga mapas nem muda a sua conta.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu carta natal, en el chat
es-ES.description: AstrologyApp convierte a ChatGPT en tu astrólogo personal, trabajando con tu carta natal real en lugar de suposiciones. Conecta tu cuenta y pregunta por tu día, tu semana, tu mes, tu año (revolución solar), los mejores días para un plan o el calendario lunar. La app entrega los datos exactos de la carta (zodíaco tropical, casas Placidus, aspectos con orbe e intensidad); ChatGPT interpreta en tu idioma. Solo las cartas con el Mapa Completo en AstrologyApp quedan conectadas. La app nunca compra nada, ni borra cartas ni cambia tu cuenta.

de-DE.subtitle: Dein Geburtshoroskop im Chat
de-DE.description: AstrologyApp macht ChatGPT zu deinem persönlichen Astrologen, der mit deinem echten Geburtshoroskop arbeitet statt zu raten. Verbinde dein Konto und frage nach deinem Tag, deiner Woche, deinem Monat, deinem Solarjahr, den besten Tagen für ein Vorhaben oder dem Mondkalender. Die App liefert die exakten Horoskopdaten (tropischer Tierkreis, Placidus-Häuser, Aspekte mit Orbis und Stärke); ChatGPT deutet sie in deiner Sprache. Nur Horoskope mit der Vollversion (Mapa Completo) bei AstrologyApp sind verbunden. Die App kauft nichts, löscht keine Horoskope und ändert dein Konto nicht.

fr-FR.subtitle: Votre thème natal, en chat
fr-FR.description: AstrologyApp fait de ChatGPT votre astrologue personnel, à partir de votre vrai thème natal plutôt que de suppositions. Connectez votre compte et interrogez votre journée, votre semaine, votre mois, votre année (révolution solaire), les meilleurs jours pour un projet ou le calendrier lunaire. L'application fournit les données exactes du thème (zodiaque tropical, maisons Placidus, aspects avec orbe et intensité) ; ChatGPT interprète dans votre langue. Seuls les thèmes avec la Carte Complète sur AstrologyApp sont connectés. L'application n'achète rien, ne supprime aucun thème et ne modifie pas votre compte.

it-IT.subtitle: Il tuo tema natale, in chat
it-IT.description: AstrologyApp trasforma ChatGPT nel tuo astrologo personale, partendo dal tuo vero tema natale invece che da supposizioni. Collega il tuo account e chiedi della tua giornata, della tua settimana, del tuo mese, del tuo anno (rivoluzione solare), dei giorni migliori per un progetto o del calendario lunare. L'app fornisce i dati esatti del tema (zodiaco tropicale, case Placidus, aspetti con orbita e intensità); ChatGPT interpreta nella tua lingua. Solo i temi con la Mappa Completa su AstrologyApp sono collegati. L'app non compra nulla, non cancella temi e non modifica il tuo account.
